documents.text: 用 t 表示当前列的 x 坐标。输入身份用 i 表示。开始 x 坐标用 l i 表示。用 r i 表示结束位置的 x 坐标。图中按身份分行展示范围。不表示不同几何高度。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">用 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">T</say-as></lang> 表<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 dang 1 qian 2 lie 4 de 5">示当前列的</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> 坐标。<break time="200ms"/>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme>用 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">I</say-as></lang> 表<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4">示</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>开始 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> 坐标用 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">L</say-as></lang> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">I</say-as></lang> 表<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4">示</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>用 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">R</say-as></lang> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">I</say-as></lang> 表<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 jie 2 shu 4 wei 4 zhi 4 de 5">示结束位置的</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> 坐标。<break time="400ms"/>图<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhong 1">中</phoneme>按<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4 fen 1 hang 2">身份分行</phoneme>展<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4">示</phoneme>范围。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>表<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 bu 4 tong 2 ji 3 he 2 gao 1 du 4">示不同几何高度</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 任何交集位置都不早于参与输入的开始位置。非零输入不竖直。非零输入的内部严格位于开始端点右边。所以非空输入的最早真实事件必是已登记端点。它之前没有活动成员或应报告的对。空输入直接得到完整空结果。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ren 4 he 2">任何</phoneme>交集<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4">位</phoneme>置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1 bu 4">都不</phoneme>早<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 2 can 1 yu 4">于参与</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>开始<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4">位</phoneme>置。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fei 1 ling 2">非零</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2">不</phoneme>竖直。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fei 1 ling 2">非零</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 nei 4 bu 4">的内部</phoneme>严<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 2 wei 4 yu 2">格位于</phoneme>开始端点右<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bian 1">边</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3 fei 1 kong 1">所以非空</phoneme>输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5 zui 4">的最</phoneme>早真实<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 jian 4">事件</phoneme>必<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 yi 3 deng 1">是已登</phoneme>记端点。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ta 1 zhi 1 qian 2 mei 2 you 3 huo 2">它之前没有活</phoneme>动成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2 huo 4 ying 1">员或应</phoneme>报<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gao 4 de 5">告的</phoneme>对。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kong 1">空</phoneme>输入直<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 1 de 2">接得</phoneme>到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wan 2">完</phoneme>整<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kong 1 jie 2 guo 3">空结果</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 本次位置用 P 表示。所有严格更早的真实事件都已经依次正确处理。而且 P 确实是下一处。这里只证明满足这两个前提以后怎样保持正确。不假定更晚的交点都已登记。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ben 3 ci 4 wei 4">本次位</phoneme>置用 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 表<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4">示</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 you 3">所有</phoneme>严<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 2 geng 4">格更</phoneme>早<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>真实<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 jian 4 dou 1 yi 3 jing 1 yi 1 ci 4 zheng 4">事件都已经依次正</phoneme>确<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2">处</phoneme>理。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="er 2 qie 3">而且</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 确实<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4">是</phoneme>下<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 chu 4">一处</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 li 3 zhi 3">这里只</phoneme>证<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ming 2">明</phoneme>满<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zu 2 zhe 4">足这</phoneme>两<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 5 qian 2 ti 2 yi 3">个前提以</phoneme>后怎<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yang 4">样</phoneme>保持<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zheng 4">正</phoneme>确。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 jia 3">不假</phoneme>定<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="geng 4">更</phoneme>晚<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>交点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1 yi 3 deng 1">都已登</phoneme>记。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 第四节保证 Q 已经在清单里。这就与清单为空产生矛盾。所以全部真实事件都已到达。第三节保证正确性一直保持到最后一个边界。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">第四<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">节</phoneme>保证 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Q</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 3 jing 1">已经</phoneme>在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qing 1 dan 1 li 3">清单里</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 jiu 4 yu 3 qing 1 dan 1 wei 2 kong 1 chan 3 sheng 1">这就与清单为空产生</phoneme>矛<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dun 4">盾</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3">所以</phoneme>全<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">部</phoneme>真实<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 jian 4 dou 1 yi 3">事件都已</phoneme>到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 2">达</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>第三<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">节</phoneme>保证<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zheng 4">正</phoneme>确性<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 4 zhi 2">一直</phoneme>保持到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zui 4">最</phoneme>后<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ge 5 bian 1">一个边</phoneme>界。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>
